description: This file defines classes and functions related to JavaScript execution contexts and handles within the Playwright core server, including evaluation, handle management, and utility functions.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript execution context within Playwright, managing evaluation and handles.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a JavaScript object in the browser context, allowing evaluation and property access.

methods.name: contextDestroyed
methods.description: Marks the execution context as destroyed, aborting ongoing evaluations.

methods.name: _raceAgainstContextDestroyed
methods.description: Races a promise against the context destruction to prevent operations after destruction.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JSON expression in the context.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates an expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Evaluates a function with arguments in the context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JSHandle object.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Releases a handle from the context.

methods.name: utilityScript
methods.description: Returns a handle to the utility script object within the context.

methods.name: doSlowMo
methods.description: Placeholder for slow motion debugging, overridden in subclasses.
